notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes:
Added audio volumes to the asylum
Fixed a couple of walls in the safehouse
Resized the Stoeger shotgun
Updated the title screen/level select room design
Further optimized Bread Island
Fixed a see-through element of the 1897 shotgun

After a long bout of burnout, and working on the other Woo Studios project, Bread Or Dead will continue. It's a bit jarring coming back to it, as I haven't played in a while, but I'll be sure to make some good changes to come.

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Overall, some big improvements to looting in this update. Some long-awaited requests like new stims and openable shelves have been added.

General Improvements

- Added new stim packs - 20%, 40%, and 60%
- Added a new stim pack model
- Fixed P250 Recoil
- Streamlined collision with a couple of pistols
- *hopefully* fixed an issue with lighter flames not appearing


Story Mode (Beta)

- Added Openable Shelves
- Added an affordance to the Bread Island time machine saying it'll send you back in time
- Added a hunger/thirst system to Story Mode, see it on your left watch
- Added a gun dealer to the Russian Apartment map
- Added new looting barrels

Plus some smaller improvements...

notes.title: Hey Bread Or Dead VR Players! Here's What We're Working On.
notes.notes:
Hello Bread Or Dead VR Players! If you've been enjoying the game recently, you might wonder what the next updates have in store. Here's a rough roadmap as to what we'll be doing.

First, I'll start with what we want to do in the short term. Squashing jank and bugs is crucial. If you have a problem, come over to our discord and we'll attempt to fix it; We get ~75% of our bugs from the community. Other than that, we want to focus on ironing out confusing mechanics (which there are a lot of). The biggest offender for that right now is the camp game mode due to complexity.

If you're wondering about new features: We want to get in some new enemies for story mode. A few ideas have been tossed around including giant dragonflies infected by the Evil Yeast or more mutated zombies. Either way, we want to increase variety in that area.

Another new feature that we want to get in is a Hunger/Thirst system for the story mode as well as more exciting looting. We've already prototyped the Hunger/Thirst system and it's working well. As for looting, we've already brought some changes to fridges that make them easier to open, but we want to crack open some of the drawers that you are physically incapable of looting as well. Some more unique doodads will adorn the shelves inside.

These short term plans will be partially rolled out by the end of this year. We're looking at 1 more update before 2025.

Next, for the long term plans. We want to prioritize getting Story Mode and Tech Tree ready long-term. Tech Tree mode has some long-standing problems we need to fix including the travel time between zones, the odd-looking nature of the scanner, and the relative lack of stylization on the UI. Also, we need to increase enemy variety and add some more events that bring chaos, whether that be zombie dogs, marauders, or a boss wave of some sort.

Story Mode is a longer story. While it's in a decent place right now, what we need to do is make saving/loading a more reliable endeavor, add Egypt and other areas as a map, create boss battles, add an actual - y'know - [i]story[/i] to story mode, and much more. This will take a while, and Story Mode will stay in the "vent" for a long time to come.

We hope you've been enjoying the current version of Bread Or Dead. Feel free to join our discord at https://discord.gg/rAhVHZnUuJ
We respond to any feedback posted and many of the things outlined here are suggestions from our community.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:

- Improved revolver shake interaction
- Improved overall weapon recoil mechanics (Currently, there's a bug with the P350)
- Improved handling logic for Bolt-actions and Double-barrels
- Fixed issues with the Marauder AI
- Added new hit detection for concrete blockers and fridges making them easier to open

Arcade Mode

- Adjusted infinite ammo pistol

Camp Mode

Story Mode (Beta)
